title: Delegated Collective Coordinator and KV Slots Optimizer
author: Priya Malhotra
description:
Motivation: tensor-parallel workloads with many short sequences and mixed batch sizes produce a high number of small NCCL collectives and fragmented KV cache allocations. This increases kernel launch overhead and reduces effective GPU bandwidth and KV cache locality under contention.

Summary: introduce a Delegated Collective Coordinator (DCC) plus a KV Slots Optimizer. The DCC defers small collective launches within a short policy window (default 1-3ms) and groups compatible launches so we execute fewer, larger NCCL operations. The KV Slots Optimizer packs small KV cache allocations into shared slabs and provides a lightweight slot reclamation heuristic that reduces fragmentation and allocation stalls. The change includes: new coordinator component (runtime/tp/collectives/coordinator.cpp/.h), a CUDA slab allocator for KV slots (runtime/kv/slot_slab.cu/.h), a runtime flag and policy knobs (config/runtime_flags.toml), observability (tracing + metrics for deferred_collectives and kv_slot_fragmentation), and tests/benchmarks.

Key ideas and design decisions: DCC runs as a per-process scheduler that inspects pending collective descriptors (shape, datatype, peer-mask). If multiple descriptors are compatible within the policy window and would target the same peer group, they are coalesced into a single NCCL launch with minimal reshaping. Compatibility rules are conservative (identical dtypes, contiguous tensors, same op type) to avoid correctness edge cases. We also added a fallback path that replays individual launches if the coalesced launch fails (NCCL errors or mismatched device topology).

KV Slots Optimizer uses a slab-based allocator for short-lived KV entries created by continuous batching. It maintains per-GPU slab pools and a best-fit small-slot index. A lazy compaction pass runs opportunistically when free space drops below 18%. The allocator was implemented to be lock-free within a stream where possible and falls back to spinlocks for cross-stream reclaim.

Performance: microbenchmarks on a 4x A100 p3dn cluster with a representative TP model and synthetic seqlen mix show: 
- aggregated token throughput +18% (steady-state) with 32-token workload, +26% with variable short sequences;
- 95th percentile latency tail reduced by ~12ms in mixed-batch tests;
- KV allocation stalls (measured as allocation latency > 0.5ms) reduced by 72%.
Real-world customer trace (anonymized) showed 14% lower per-token GPU utilization variance and fewer spike recoveries.

Safety and toggles: feature gated behind runtime flag (runtime.flags.enable_delegated_collectives = true) and a per-tenant policy. Default rollout: disabled on main; enabled in Dedicated canary clusters for 2 weeks before global rollout. We added an emergency kill switch and an automatic revert hook if error rate jumps > 2x.

Testing & validation: unit tests for slot allocator and coordinator matching rules, integration test that compares outputs vs legacy path (bitwise equality for deterministic layers, statistical check for nondeterministic ops), synthetic perf bench harness, and CI integration tests. Benchmarks are reproducible under benchmarks/tp/kv_slots_bench.md.

Checklist: [x] design doc linked (ENG-1427) [x] unit tests [x] integration tests [x] perf bench results attached [x] metrics + tracing added [x] docs/rollout notes added

Migration notes: no user-visible API changes. Admins may see new runtime flags. Rollout should be gradual to catch topology-specific regressions (heterogeneous link rates).

Risks: coalescing adds complexity to scheduling; conservative compatibility checks chosen to avoid correctness issues. NCCL multi-op fusion depends on topology (NVLink vs PCIe) — DCC respects peer-group bandwidth hints.

Files of interest and short rationale: runtime/tp/collectives/coordinator.cpp - core DCC logic and coalescer; runtime/kv/slot_slab.cu - slab allocator for small KV entries (optimized CUDA kernels for memcpy/memset coalescing); runtime/scheduler/slot_allocator.rs - integration with continuous batching to reserve slots ahead of a batch; tests/tp/collective_integration_test.py - end-to-end validation; docs/perf/kv_slots.md - operational guidance and flags.

Next steps: canary rollout, telemetry monitoring, and follow-up improvements to allow multi-shape coalescing (future work ENG-1502).

release_notes: Introduce Delegated Collective Coordinator to coalesce small NCCL collectives and a KV Slots Optimizer to reduce KV allocation fragmentation. Improves throughput and latency for short-sequence tensor-parallel workloads. Feature is disabled by default and gated via runtime flag.
notes_for_ops: Enable runtime.flags.enable_delegated_collectives on canary clusters first. Monitor metrics: runtime.deferred_collectives.count, runtime.deferred_collectives.coalesce_rate, runtime.kv_slot_fragmentation, and per-tenant error_rate. Rollback if error_rate > 2x or coalesce_rate remains near 0 (indicates compatibility mis-match).
